Belly

1998
Watched 06 Aug 2026

every scene is art, esp the opening scene. love how colour and contrast is used in so many scenes to great effect. every house in the movie has striking architecture, and you genuinely feel how grimy Jamaica is (briefly)
excellent acting from dmx and nas, but the story is non existent and predictable, if not straight up cheesy and preachy towards the end. still, a visual treat by one of the best creatives of this century. the story is a massive letdown, would totally see a remake of this with a much harder hitting storyline.
